state_definition: Four coarse observable groups, not learned or validated hidden regimes. Trend sign uses inherited trend60 =60bar close log change / (population sd of60daily log returns floored1e-8 * sqrt60). Negative if trend60<0; exactzero nonnegative. Volatility20 is inherited population sd of20daily log returns; low if <=annual mature rolling5 training median(linear .5 quantile), high otherwise. Annual calibration only; reset at priorDec31, same boundaries for every quarter, method and seed. No choice of state count, sign cutoff, quantile or features from subgroup outcomes. This is a new4cell diagnostic using existing descriptors, not the old R17sixcell partition or R29state90 update trigger.
experiment: Fixed acceptance origin: availability of five new mature state weeks before unchanged expiry
scope: Read-only metadata counts for all 84 original R40 formal state acceptances, including R18 diagnostic and three primary methods. Keep every acceptance as an independent observation origin even when a later monthly gate clears or replaces its actual record. These diagnostic tracks never alter original live or historical routing. No parameter fit, probability scoring, predictive accuracy, PnL or p values.
origins: Formal accepted R40 state gates copied through R43 only; sourcecutoff,method,state,three seed coefficients and original evidence remain frozen. Do not choose origins by later outcomes. Deduplicate date/state events separately so repeated method acceptances are not portrayed as independent markets.
expiry: First calendar quarter end strictly after original formal acceptance cutoff, unchanged from R42. Later formal acceptances do not reset an earlier diagnostic origin. At decision D>=expiry that old source is no longer actionable for subsequent signals. Count-only feasibility is distinct from parameter validity or authorization to retain a cleared/expired coefficient.
pool: Original 272 weekly observations, deduplicated across four methods and three seeds after metadata equality checks. Counting uses only row_index,date,joint_completed,state,year and encoder_cutoff; never labels, returns or probabilities. A new observation means joint_completed strictly after sourcecutoff and no later than checkpoint. Signal date can precede sourcecutoff when its label was not mature yet; record this explicitly.
cadence: Preplanned monthly calendar checkpoints source<D<=expiry. Include checkpoint at expiry for endpoint diagnostics, but primary actionable decision must satisfy D<expiry. All observed checkpoints are <=fixed label_end2026-08-31; Aug31 is a metadata-only extension beyond original candidate schedule lastJul31, with no new model/head/gate. Later checkpoints have unknown counts and are never treated as zero.

views.cumulative: All matching-state original weekly observations with source<joint_completed<=checkpoint, within source annual state-boundary year. This is the primary information-arrival count.
views.rolling13: Intersect the same novel set with the latest13 overall mature original weekly observations at checkpoint, matching original validation-memory capacity. Report drops rather than assume all cumulative evidence remains in current validation.

threshold: Fixed5 unique state weeks; no threshold/expiry/state/cadence search. At every observed checkpoint record n>=5, terminal equality versus usable pre-expiry, original metadata provenance, fifth maturity date for cumulative, earliest decision for each view, remaining known signal opportunities after that decision and through expiry.
classification: Per origin/view: reached_before_expiry if any observed checkpoint D<expiry has count>=5; reached_only_at_expiry if complete observation through expiry and only endpoint has count>=5; not_reached_by_expiry if complete lifetime but never enough; observation_censored if lifetime incomplete and no observed pre-expiry hit. Censored is not a negative result. Also classify scheduled_firstopportunity before expiry with zero remaining observed signal coverage separately via coverage fields; do not invent post-data signals.
availability: Readiness is information capacity only. Count observed future signal dates strictly later than first ready decision and <=min(expiry,label_end), distinguishing same-state from all-state weeks and recording right censoring. Counts do not prove old/new parameters pass Brier or direction gates.
outputs: Freeze all84 origins and deduplicated metadata before counting; retain all planned checkpoints including unknown future ones and all zero-evidence origins. Per-origin histories and source-week membership, view summaries by source year/early/recent/all and method, unique date/state events, only count-based feasibility. Original 23 histories, prediction and metric files byte-identical; 5800 old files unchanged.
verification: Independent calendar month/quarter arithmetic, origin/metadata/source membership and earliest-readiness classification. Synthetic checks for inclusive maturity cutoff, strict old-source pre-expiry actionability, immature labels with earlier signal dates, duplicate observations, rolling13 capacity, no reset at lateracceptance and rightcensoring. Poison labels/probabilities/outcomes and nonaccepted/later source-gate fields without altering metadata; count outputs invariant. At every observed checkpoint remove as-yet immature metadata rows and require current count invariant. No future membership used in earlier readiness.
limitations: All source history previously examined. This experiment changes only diagnostic anchoring and looks at sample availability, not strategy performance. Sources overlap in time and can share evidence; unique origin/week pairs are not independent sample size. Cumulative data may differ from retained13-window data. Existing source selection is conditioned on earlier formal validation. No new blindholdout or baseline promotion.
